Records carry subtopic slugs rather than subtopic_label text. The notes repo covers discrete mathematics only, so no card serves them.
New lesson topics/synchronisation-and-deadlock (added 2026-10-27, PUBLISHED, 55 aliases) serves no notes card; the notes repo has no operating-systems subject yet.

Mock unit 3 'Calculus: Limits, Continuity & Differentiability' holds 50 questions over 4 subtopics (indeterminate-forms-lhopital 14, continuity-analysis 12, mean-value-theorems 12, partial-derivatives 12) and no notes card exists for any of them; the notes repo covers discrete mathematics only.
Lesson topics/cpu-scheduling (PUBLISHED 2026-10-27, 26 microtopics from FCFS/SJF/SRTF/round robin to MLFQ) serves no notes card; the notes repo has no operating-systems subject yet.

New mock set, Digital Logic Unit 3 'Sequential Circuits: Flip-Flops & Registers' (run 5, 2026-10-27, paper gate_dl_mock_3_2026-10-27.html), holds 25 questions over 4 subtopic_label groups (Latches vs flip-flops 8, Shift registers 6, Setup & hold times 6, Characteristic equations 5). The notes repo covers discrete mathematics only, so no card serves any of them. Lesson topics/sequential-circuits (PUBLISHED 2026-10-27, topic-level) already covers all four subtopics, so the missing piece is the notes card.

gaps.detail: Unit 7 'Counting & Combinatorics' (unit_slug combinatorics, run 6, 2026-10-28) now holds 25 questions over 5 subtopic_label groups of 5 each: Permutations & combinations, Binomial & multinomial coefficients, Double counting, Stars and bars, Inclusion-exclusion counting. The remaining combinatorics cards above have no group in the unit that matches their subtopic: DODB (k^n), IOIB partitions, derangements and the playlist-gap recurrence card are not represented in the bank.

No published lesson covers Stirling numbers of the second kind, integer partitions or binomial-theorem coefficient extraction; counting-and-combinatorics stops at stars and bars, inclusion-exclusion, surjections and derangements.
topics/propositional-logic has no scene on CNF/DNF, resolution or NAND completeness; its 10 scenes stop at equivalence, valid arguments and satisfiability.

gaps.placement: discrete-mathematics › first-order-logic › fol-validity-and-implication, fol-tautology-vs-validity, fol-exactly-one-and-uniqueness, fol-model-size-and-countermodels, fol-quantifier-inference-rules
gaps.detail: topics/first-order-logic covers predicates, both quantifiers, the domain, quantifier negation, quantifier order and free/bound variables only; validity, uniqueness, countermodels and quantifier inference rules are absent from its transcript.

New mock set, Compiler Design Unit 2 'Syntax Analysis: Top-Down Parsing' (runs 3 and 4, 2026-10-27, paper compiler-design/top-down-parsing/gate_cd_mock_2_2026-10-27.html), holds 50 questions, at the unit cap, over 4 groups counted from the bank's subtopic field (first-and-follow-sets 15, left-recursion-and-factoring 12, recursive-descent-parsers 12, ll1-parsing-tables 11). This bank carries no subtopic_label field, so the subtopic field is the grouping. The notes repo covers discrete mathematics only, so no card serves any of them.

New lesson topics/file-systems (added 2026-10-27, PUBLISHED, 10 scenes, 29 microtopics in syllabus-coverage.json) covers file and directory structure, contiguous, linked and indexed allocation, FAT and inode pointer trees, free space management, hard and symbolic links, and the disk-access counts of an open and an insert. The notes repo has no operating-systems subject, so no card serves it.

New mock set, Programming and Data Structures Unit 2 'Pointers, Memory & Preprocessors' Set 2 of 2 (run 4, 2026-10-27, paper programming-data-structures/pointers-memory/gate_ds_mock_2_2026-10-27.html); the unit now holds 50 questions, at the 50-question cap, over 4 subtopic_label groups (Pointer arithmetic 14, Pointers to functions 12, Dynamic memory allocation 12, Macro expansion, scope & lifetime 12). The notes repo covers discrete mathematics only, so no card serves them.

New lesson topics/disk-scheduling (added 2026-10-27, PUBLISHED, 10 scenes) covers FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK and C-LOOK, head movement arithmetic and the seek/rotational-latency/transfer cost model, and serves no notes card; the notes repo has no operating-systems subject yet.

No published lesson covers function pointers or dynamic memory allocation: the topics/pointers-in-c transcript contains no mention of either, and its subtopics stop at pointer arithmetic, array decay, sizeof semantics, pointer to pointer and dangling pointers. Unit 2's other two groups are served by pointers-in-c (Pointer arithmetic) and functions-scope-and-preprocessor (Macro expansion, scope & lifetime).

Mock set, Compiler Design Unit 3 'Syntax Analysis: Bottom-Up Parsing' (run 7, 2026-10-28, paper compiler-design/bottom-up-parsing/gate_cd_mock_3_2026-10-28.html, Set 1 archived) now holds 50 questions, at the unit cap, over 4 groups counted from the bank's subtopic field: lr0-items-parsing 14, slr1-parsing-conflicts 12, lr1-and-lalr1-parsers 13, operator-precedence-parsing 11. The bank carries no subtopic_label field, so the subtopic slug is the grouping. The run note states the next Compiler Design run advances to Unit 4, Syntax-Directed Translation & Intermediate Code. The notes repo covers discrete mathematics only, so no card serves any of them.

New lesson topics/relational-algebra-and-sql (registered 2026-10-27; syllabus-coverage.json coverage_status PUBLISHED, lesson_slug relational-algebra-and-sql, 4 subtopics: relational algebra operators, tuple relational calculus, SQL queries/joins/subqueries, ER to relational mapping). Its transcript.md was read: 10 scenes covering the six primitives, projection against SELECT DISTINCT, joins and relational division. The notes repo has no databases subject, so no card serves it. The databases bank already holds unit 1 er-relational-algebra with 50 questions (relational-algebra-select-project-join-division 16, er-diagrams-cardinality-weak-entities 12, relational-model-constraints 12, tuple-and-domain-relational-calculus 10), so only the notes card is missing.

The notes repo has no databases subject, so no card serves it.

New lesson topics/regular-expressions-and-finite-automata (added 2026-10-28; topics.json entry created/updated 2026-10-28; syllabus-coverage.json subject Theory of Computation, unit Regular languages, coverage_status PUBLISHED, 5 subtopics, 22 microtopics). Its transcript.md was read: 10 scenes covering alphabet/Sigma-star, the five-tuple, nondeterminism and epsilon-closure, subset construction against the 2^n bound, distinguishability and table filling, counters modulo m with the lcm rule, Thompson's construction, state elimination and closure properties, and the pumping lemma. New lesson topics/transactions-and-concurrency-control (added 2026-10-27, syllabus-coverage.json subject Databases, unit Transactions, coverage_status PUBLISHED, 8 subtopics, 21 microtopics) serves no notes card: the notes repo has only the discrete-mathematics subject. Covers ACID, conflict and view serialisability, precedence graphs, recoverability, 2PL, timestamp ordering and the Thomas write rule.

Mock unit 7 group 'Double counting' (5 questions: handshakes, cards sent, sum k*C(10,k)) matches no card. The nearest card is basic-counting-rules, whose sum/product/subtraction/bijection rules do not include counting one set two ways, so no link was written.

New lesson topics/layering-switching-and-performance-metrics (added 2026-10-27, PUBLISHED, 10 scenes in transcript.md, 7 subtopics and 20 microtopics in syllabus-coverage.json) covers layering principles, OSI and TCP/IP stacks, encapsulation and per-hop versus end-to-end addressing, circuit/packet/virtual-circuit switching, store-and-forward against cut-through, transmission, propagation and queuing delay, pipelined end-to-end delay over N links, throughput as the bottleneck and the bandwidth-delay product; checked against transcript.md, not the alias list. The notes repo has no computer-networks subject, so no card serves it. The mock unit on the same ground is computer-networks/network-fundamentals-framing (50 questions: osi-and-tcp-ip-models 13, transmission-delays-bandwidth-delay-product 12, framing-bit-byte-stuffing 12, error-detection-crc-checksum-hamming 13).
